nas.nordic-advanced-systems-is: Nordic Advanced Systems is a Danish company that develops and manufactures propulsion systems for UAV platforms. The engines are used in operations where propulsion must function correctly and predictably throughout the mission. The focus is on stable operation, consistent quality, and known behavior under load.
nas.in-many-uav-operations: In many UAV operations, it is essential that the propulsion system behaves consistently from unit to unit and can be produced and delivered in series with known characteristics. NAS develops engines based on this premise.

conduct.meta.title: Code of Conduct — Nordic Advanced Systems
conduct.meta.description: Nordic Advanced Systems Code of Conduct and Compliance. Ethical business conduct, quality management, data protection, and responsible operations.
conduct.danish-law-eu-regulations: Danish law · EU regulations · International standards
conduct.at-nas-nordic-advanced: At NAS (Nordic Advanced Systems), we are committed to conducting business with integrity, transparency, and responsibility. We follow all applicable laws and internal policies to ensure that we operate according to the highest ethical standards. We do not tolerate any form of bribery, corruption, facilitation payments, or improper advantage.
conduct.we-operate-under-a: We operate under a self-developed and certified Quality Management System (QMS), which ensures that our products and services meet the highest quality standards. The QMS is based on continuous improvement, audits, and strict quality control. This ensures that we consistently deliver reliable and high-performing solutions to our partners.
conduct.we-handle-all-data: We handle all data with great care and in compliance with applicable data protection regulations, including GDPR. Confidentiality is a fundamental principle at NAS, and we ensure that information from partners, employees, and stakeholders is treated with the highest level of security and discretion.
conduct.employees-and-representatives-of: Employees and representatives of NAS must avoid situations where personal interests conflict with company interests. Any potential conflict must be reported immediately so that an appropriate and transparent solution can be found.
conduct.nas-strives-to-create: NAS strives to create an inclusive, safe, and respectful workplace for all employees. Discrimination, harassment, or bullying are not tolerated. We promote equal opportunities regardless of nationality, gender, age, or background. As an international company, we value the diversity of our global team and ensure that all employees are onboarded and employed in accordance with Danish law and international labor standards.
conduct.nas-complies-with-all: NAS complies with all applicable international trade laws, customs requirements, and sanctions regimes. We ensure that all production and trade activities are carried out in alignment with EU and local regulations in the countries where we operate.
conduct.we-expect-our-suppliers: We expect our suppliers and partners to comply with the same ethical, legal, and quality standards as NAS. We conduct due diligence in our supply chain to prevent corruption, human rights violations, and environmental harm, and we work only with responsible and reliable partners.
conduct.nas-is-committed-to: NAS is committed to respecting internationally recognized human rights and labor standards, including the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights. We also seek to minimize our environmental footprint and continuously work towards sustainable solutions in both production and international trade.
conduct.nas-is-committed-to-2: NAS is committed to financial transparency and integrity. We comply with all applicable anti-money laundering (AML) and financial regulations, ensuring that our business activities and relationships are conducted with accountability and trustworthiness.
conduct.nas-complies-with-all-2: NAS complies with all relevant laws and regulations in the countries where we operate. This includes requirements for safety, health, and environmental protection. By adhering to both international and local standards, we ensure that our activities are fully aligned with responsible business practices.

Two different boards, each with its own voltage range and flight controller.
drone-stack.flight-controller-and-esc: Flight controller and ESC engineered for continuous operation. The NAS Drone Stack {spec:ds65.currentTight} pairs a flight controller with a 4-in-1 electronic speed controller on a single stack: the FC carries the sensing, link and logging; the ESC carries the current.

efi.meta.title: NAS IEMS — Intelligent Engine Management — Nordic Advanced Systems
efi.meta.description: NAS IEMS — Nordic Advanced Systems' proprietary Integrated Engine Management System combining EFI, CDI and ECU technology for professional UAV propulsion.
efi.drone-stack-fc-stack: Drone StackFC STACK EFIFuel Injection
efi.intelligent-engine-management-for: Intelligent Engine Management for Professional UAV Platforms.
efi.nas-iems-is-nordic: NAS IEMS is Nordic Advanced Systems' proprietary digital engine management platform, purpose-built for professional UAV propulsion systems — integrating Electronic Fuel Injection (EFI), Capacitor Discharge Ignition (CDI) and proprietary ECU technology into one intelligent control platform.

efi.capacitor-discharge-ignition-ecucontroll: Capacitor Discharge Ignition — ECU-controlled ignition timing.
efi.proprietary-hardware-embedded-software: Proprietary hardware & embedded software — the brain of the system.
efi.nas-iems-system-architecture: NAS IEMS system architecture: sensor inputs feed the ECU, which controls both the EFI and CDI subsystems, and both drive the engine.
efi.nas-iems-is-developed: NAS IEMS is developed entirely around Nordic Advanced Systems' proprietary EFI, CDI and ECU hardware, embedded software and control strategies, protected by our own Intellectual Property (IP). Built on an NDAA-compliant European chipset, the platform provides customers with a secure, scalable and future-ready engine management solution for professional UAV and defence applications.
efi.nas-iems-is-available: NAS IEMS is available both as part of a complete Nordic Advanced Systems propulsion package and as a standalone engine management solution for compatible third-party engines. Working closely with OEMs and UAV manufacturers, our engineering team supports platform integration, ECU calibration and engine mapping to ensure optimum performance on each individual propulsion system.
efi.every-engine-platform-has: Every engine platform has unique operating characteristics. Using our dedicated engine test facilities, Nordic Advanced Systems performs platform-specific calibration, validation and performance optimization to deliver a fully integrated, mission-ready propulsion solution.
efi.validation-on-dedicated-engine: Validation on dedicated engine test facilities
efi.designed-for-professional-uav: Designed for professional UAV & defence applications
efi.available-for-nas-engines: Available for NAS engines and compatible third-party engines
efi.whether-you-require-a: Whether you require a complete propulsion system or wish to integrate NAS IEMS with your existing engine platform, Nordic Advanced Systems provides engineering support from initial integration through production-ready validation. Technical documentation and platform-specific configurations are available upon request and, where appropriate, under a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA).
